title: Compact Rollout Toolbar: keyboard access, copy affordances, and visual sweep
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Design review ticket for the compact rollout toolbar that appears on rollout cards in the Console. Focus areas: keyboard accessibility (tab order, focus rings, aria labels), copy affordances (copy rollout ID, copy config snapshot link), and a visual polish pass to align with the new compact density token set. Includes prototype updates, a QA checklist, and decisions on trade-offs for hover vs persistent affordances.
acceptance_criteria: Toolbar components reachable via keyboard in logical order and announced correctly by screen readers
Copy buttons for rollout ID and snapshot produce native clipboard events and show transient confirmation toasts
Compact density token set applied without clipping microcopy or overflow at 320px min width
Design spec includes hover, focus, active, disabled, and motion-reduced states
Prototype runnable in Figma and interactive prototype link for QA
Dev handoff assets (icons, spacing tokens, aria copy) uploaded to Drive and linked in ticket
design_decisions: Use a single-line compact toolbar (max 3 icons) to reduce cognitive noise on glance mode
Show copy affordances as icon-only by default; reveal label on focus to save horizontal space
Prefer transient toast on copy instead of inline label mutation to keep layout stable
Reduce motion for focus ring pulse if user has prefers-reduced-motion; provide 0.12s fade for accessible feedback
Avoid persistent borders in compact mode; use subtle surface elevation and tokenized gaps to indicate grouping
